projects.title: Guardrails PoC (CyCraft)
projects.background: The bank plans to deploy 4 AI Agents. Before launch, the bank must verify the AI protection controls.
projects.problem: The bank had no in-house method to verify Guardrails. Vendor test results did not prove safety for the bank's own use cases.
approach: Design a test set for 6 Policy modules, based on the OWASP LLM Top 10.
Build a baseline: 40 cases per module, 240 cases in total.
Expand the test set from feedback: 100 cases per module, 600 cases in total.
Run 3,600 verifications in batches through the API.
Fix the System Prompt from the failed cases, then test again.
result: Completed 600-case verification and prompt tuning for all 6 Policies.
Covered 4 layers of AI safety: sensitive data, prompt attacks, business scope, and response compliance.
Built a reusable in-house verification method for the 4 Agents.
projects.keyProgress: 600-case verification and prompt tuning are complete for all 6 Policies. The verification report and adoption proposal are in progress.

goal.target: Complete the Guardrails PoC. Set the bank's AI protection specification.
goal.achievement: Test set and verification are complete. The report is in progress.

projects.title: AI Agent Cost Model & 3-Year TCO / ROI
projects.background: The bank plans 4 AI Agents: Sales, Credit, Service, and Wealth Assistant. Resource allocation needs a cost and benefit basis.
projects.problem: Each Agent has a different cost structure: on-premises GPU, cloud tokens, and software. The bank had no single model to compare them.
approach: Define the resource formula: AI Agent demand = space (GPU memory) × time (GPU compute).
Build the capacity model: 5 RTX PRO 6000 cards (96 GB each), 480 GB and 432,000 card-seconds per day.
Build the on-premises amortization model: memory is a fixed cost, compute is a variable cost.
Build the cloud token model: monthly cost = volume × tokens in/out per journey × unit price.
Build the benefit model: monthly benefit = volume × unit improvement × unit value.
Create a data request form to collect model specifications from 4 vendors.
result: Delivered 3 cost models (capacity, on-premises amortization, cloud tokens) and the vendor data request form.
Collected business volumes: Service 43,000 calls/month; Wealth Assistant 324,959 logins/month; Credit 13,513 cases/month.
Estimated Credit Agent cloud token cost: about NT$1.92 per case; about NT$346,591 / 384,717 / 427,034 for years 1–3.
Built a 3-year TCO, TBE, and ROI comparison format for the 4 Agents.
